claims.text: The Beaumont Mayfair is an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude in central London.

findings.quote: The Beaumont Mayfair pulls off a rare feat of being an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude, brimming with the vibrant charm of its central London neighbourhood.

claims.text: Each room has a unique selection of original prints, books and paintings.

findings.quote: Each room is tailored for individuality, with a unique selection of original prints, books and paintings.

claims.text: Premier Rooms use bronze mirrors, mohair velvets and silks that reflect an Art Deco aesthetic.

findings.quote: Bronze mirrors, mohair velvets and sumptuous silks reflect a sophisticated Art Deco aesthetic.

claims.text: Each Mayfair Suite has its own library of specially selected reading material.

findings.quote: Each features an extensive library of specially selected reading material.

claims.text: The Roosevelt Suite is available as a one-bedroom or a five-bedroom suite.

findings.quote: The Roosevelt Suite is available as a one-bedroom (169m²) or a five-bedroom (606m²) suite.

claims.text: The Junior Suite Wing groups a Deluxe Junior Suite, a Premier Junior Suite and a Superior Grand Room in a separate corridor, for families or larger groups.

findings.quote: For families or larger groups, The Junior Suite Wing provides an exclusive residential-style experience.
This private enclave includes a Deluxe Junior Suite, a Premier Junior Suite, and a Superior Grand Room, all set within a discreet, separate corridor

claims.text: Superior Grand Rooms can interconnect, suiting guests travelling with children.

findings.quote: Perfect for those looking for extra space or travelling with children, these expansive rooms can interconnect to provide even more space.

claims.text: Signature suites include a fully complimentary mini bar, including alcohol.

findings.quote: Fully complimentary mini bar,

claims.text: Some Superior Grand rooms are designed to be fully accessible for guests with reduced mobility.

findings.quote: Some Superior Grand rooms are designed to be fully accessible for guests with reduced mobility.

claims.text: The hotel's restaurant is Rosi, and Le Magritte is the hotel bar, serving classic cocktails.

findings.quote: The Beaumont Mayfair's glamorous restaurant Rosi is making waves, while Le Magritte, a timeless Mayfair hotel bar, serves classic cocktails and stylish snacks.

claims.text: The Gatsby Room serves afternoon tea and a wide range of Champagnes.

findings.quote: The Gatsby Room is a relaxed, intimate perfect spot to enjoy afternoon tea and a wide range of Champagnes.

claims.text: The bedroom of the ROOM suite sits inside a giant semi-abstract sculpture by Sir Antony Gormley on the hotel's entrance front on Brown Hart Gardens.

findings.quote: The bedroom of this unique suite occupies the interior of a giant semi-abstract sculpture by Sir Antony Gormley, which dominates the entrance front of The Beaumont Mayfair on Brown Hart Gardens.

claims.text: Inside ROOM, a dark oak-clad bedroom is reached up nine white marble steps and separated by a black velvet curtain from a white marble bathroom; outside, its stainless steel form is a giant crouching figure based on the artist's body.

findings.quote: The interior, which forms the dark oak-clad bedroom of a one-bedroom suite, is approached up nine white marble steps, separated by a black velvet curtain from a pure white marble bathroom.
the stainless steel exterior, which represents a giant crouching cuboid figure based on the artist's body.

findings.quote: these are the largest of our one-bedroom suites. Each has its own unique layout, most overlook Brown Hart Gardens or the rooftops of Mayfair.
